 "command": "cat > programs/task-f937d880.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full horizontal color bars encode a vertical periodic sequence.
    nonempty_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r])]
    if nonempty_rows and all(all(v != 0 for v in grid[r]) and len(set(grid[r])) == 1
                              for r in nonempty_rows):
        for p in range(1, min(h, 30) + 1):
            seq = {}
            ok = True
            for r in nonempty_rows:
                v = grid[r][0]
                k = r % p
                if k in seq and seq[k] != v:
                    ok = False
                    break
                seq[k] = v
            if ok and len(seq) == p:
                return [[seq[r % p] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Sparse diagonal samples encode a cyclic sequence indexed by c-r.
    samples = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    for p in range(1, min(max(h, w), 30) + 1):
        seq = {}
        ok = True
        for r, c, v in samples:
            k = (c - r) % p
            if k in seq and seq[k] != v:
                ok = False
                break
            seq[k] = v
        if ok and len(seq) == p:
            return [[seq[(c - r) % p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('Could not infer a fully specified periodic sequence')

 "command": "cat > programs/task-f937d880.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    active_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r])]

    # Horizontal bars: each occupied row encodes one phase of the repeating row pattern.
    if active_rows and all(len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0
                           for r in active_rows):
        period = len(active_rows)
        phase = {}
        for r in active_rows:
            phase[r % period] = grid[r][0]
        return [[phase[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Parallel diagonal tracks encode phases of a cyclic diagonal pattern.
    offsets = sorted({c - r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0})
    if not offsets:
        return [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    period = len(offsets)
    phase = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color:
                k = (c - r) % period
                if k in phase and phase[k] != color:
                    raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal phase colors")
                phase[k] = color
    return [[phase.get((c - r) % period, 0) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    active_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r])]

    # Horizontal bars encode a repeating row sequence.
    if active_rows and all(len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0
                           for r in active_rows):
        period = len(active_rows)
        phase = {r % period: grid[r][0] for r in active_rows}
        return [[phase[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Parallel diagonal tracks encode a cyclic pattern by diagonal offset.
    offsets = sorted({c - r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0})
    if not offsets:
        return [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    period = len(offsets)
    phase = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color:
                k = (c - r) % period
                if k in phase and phase[k] != color:
                    raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal phase colors")
                phase[k] = color
    return [[phase.get((c - r) % period, 0) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
